style: bold flat vector cartoon, thick dark outline, chunky casual mobile game art, high saturation, flat two-tone shading
notes: One art style for the whole project, written word for word at the head of every prompt. Every sprite that takes part in the mechanic declares its orientation in words: the diverter arm and the back chevron are asymmetric and are named facing right and facing left, so the code can mirror them deliberately; everything else is symmetric and is never mirrored. The six nine-sliced sprites (doorway, shutter, glass tube, guide rail, nameplate, plate) ask for flat stretchable edges, because their import settings give them a real border. No prompt argues about the background colour - the pipeline cuts it away. There is no audio asset of any kind. No prompt contains the application name and no sprite carries lettering: the splash and menu mark is an abstract crown over a fruit crate. The icon hero is one object, a crowned apple.
